localLetRHS.physical:
fun x : Fin n → Ω =>
              if Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x) = 0 then 0 else
                (projectionW n g x + residualStatisticD n r x) /
                  Real.sqrt (centeredSq n g r x)
localLetRHS.clipped: clippedCenteredStatistic n g r 512 rho z
localLetRHS.Eclip: {x : Fin n → Ω | clipped x ≠ physical x}
